name: Signature Cut
description: Our premium haircut service includes consultation, precision cut, neck shave, and styling. Tailored to your unique style.

name: Fade & Line Up
description: Expert fade with crisp line-up and edge work. Includes consultation, cut, neck shave, and styling.

name: Kids Cut (12 & Under)
description: Professional haircut for children 12 and under. Patient and experienced barbers who work great with kids.

name: Beard Trim & Shape
description: Precision beard trimming and shaping to complement your style. Includes hot towel and conditioning treatment.

name: Hot Towel Shave
description: Traditional straight razor shave with hot towel treatment, pre-shave oil, and post-shave balm. The ultimate relaxation experience.

name: Full Service Package
description: The complete grooming experience: signature cut, beard trim, hot towel shave, facial massage, and styling. Leave looking and feeling your absolute best.

name: Hair Design & Art
description: Custom hair designs, patterns, and artistic details. Pricing varies by complexity - consultation included.

name: Buzz Cut
description: Quick and clean buzz cut with guard of your choice. Includes neck shave and line-up.
